notes.title: v2.4.0 - Unnecessary objects have been removed.
notes.content:
v2.4.0 - The change is as follows:
[list]
[*]Unnecessary objects have been removed, and optimization has been performed.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.3.0 - Controller sensitivity adjustment.
notes.content:
v2.3.0 - The changes are as follows:
[list]
[*]I have expanded the adjustable range of controller sensitivity.
[*]I have fixed a bug related to the volume adjustment text display in the English version of the options menu.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.2.0 - Added English support
notes.content:
v2.2.0 - Added English support. 
Translation by a native speaker has been completed. 
From now on, you can enjoy the interface, full audio, and subtitles in English. 

Please take the opportunity to enjoy it!

notes.title: Release 2.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Adjusted the difficulty of the final stage.
[*]Changed certain parts of the diary of a character costume creator.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed wall clipping under certain conditions.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.0.0.
notes.content:
[b]I have released v2.0.0.[/b]
The changes are as follows:

[b]・Added new gimmicks needed to complete the final stage.[/b]
・Adjusted the game difficulty.
・Extended the time limit for the mini-game of pressing the correct buttons at the entrance to the abandoned factory.
・Fixed a place where unexpected avoidance actions could be taken in front of the emergency stop button in the factory.
